review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The Senior Systems Administrator is a key member of that team. This role owns the infrastructure reliability of an assigned portfolio of plant sites, serves as the senior technical resource for Systems Administrators in their geographic area, and contributes to enterprise-level projects and standards that affect the full RLG estate. L1 and L2 support is handled by an outsourced MSP; the Senior Systems Administrator owns everything above that threshold. Key Responsibilities Site Infrastructure Re
eligibility_evidence: Provide clear, specific technical direction to MSP remote hands during on-site work at your sites.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Maintain awareness of site-level security posture; execute patching schedules, EOL device retirement, and security baseline requirements on time. Key Qualifications Education and Certifications Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience. Experience 5 or more years of IT infrastructure experience in a multi-site or enterprise environment, with demonstrated ownership of site-level infrastructure rather than support queue participation. Virtualization: hands-on experience with VMware ESXi and/or Proxmox VE. Familiarity with ERP shop floor environments and the infrastructure requirements that support them is an asset (e.g., Radius, LabelTraxx).
